sort.title_vi: Động từ/cụm từ nào đi với V-ing, cái nào đi với to V?

unjumble.sentence: My little brother enjoys drawing cartoon characters after school.
We hope to visit the art exhibition this weekend.
She is really good at playing the đàn tranh.
We stopped to take photos of the colourful lanterns.
unjumble.hint_vi: stop + to V = dừng lại để làm việc khác

unjumble.sentence: My parents agreed to take me to the concert.

truefalse.s: I enjoy to paint landscapes in my free time.
truefalse.fix: I enjoy painting landscapes in my free time.
truefalse.why_vi: enjoy luôn đi với V-ing: enjoy painting.

truefalse.s: Linh has decided to enter the poetry competition.
truefalse.fix: Linh has decided to enter the poetry competition.
truefalse.why_vi: decide + to V: decided to enter. Câu đúng.

truefalse.s: We are looking forward to see the new musical.
truefalse.fix: We are looking forward to seeing the new musical.
truefalse.why_vi: 'to' trong look forward to là giới từ, nên sau nó dùng V-ing.

truefalse.s: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
truefalse.fix: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
truefalse.why_vi: mind + V-ing: Would you mind turning…? Câu đúng.

truefalse.s: The band refused playing without their drummer.
truefalse.fix: The band refused to play without their drummer.
truefalse.why_vi: refuse + to V: refused to play.

truefalse.s: Mai stopped to admire a painting near the door.
truefalse.fix: Mai stopped to admire a painting near the door.
truefalse.why_vi: stop to do = dừng lại ĐỂ làm việc khác (ngắm bức tranh). Câu đúng.

truefalse.s: Remember locking the door before you go to the concert.
truefalse.fix: Remember to lock the door before you go to the concert.
truefalse.why_vi: Việc chưa làm, phải nhớ để làm → remember to do.

truefalse.s: My sister is interested in designing costumes for the theatre.
truefalse.fix: My sister is interested in designing costumes for the theatre.
truefalse.why_vi: Sau giới từ in dùng V-ing: interested in designing. Câu đúng.

exam.intro_vi: Đề chuyên Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 8 câu điền từ vào đoạn văn: mỗi chỗ trống chọn A, B, C hoặc D. Các câu kiểm tra cả từ vựng, cụm động từ và ngữ pháp.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: đọc cả câu và từ ngay trước, ngay sau chỗ trống (giới từ 'to', 'at'…) để biết cần V-ing, to V hay một từ hợp nghĩa.
exam.text: My cousin Hân has always enjoyed [1] to traditional Vietnamese music. Two years ago, she started lessons on the đàn bầu, an instrument with only one string. At first, it was so difficult that she wanted to give up, but her teacher kept encouraging her. After six months, she managed [2] some simple folk songs, and everyone in her family was amazed. Last spring, Hân even played a short piece of her own. She had [3] it for her grandmother's birthday. Then, in December, her music club [4] a concert at the city theatre to raise money for poor children. Hân was nervous, but the audience stood up and clapped for a long time. After the show, several teenagers told her that she had inspired them to learn a traditional instrument too. Now Hân is looking forward to [5] at a music festival in Huế next summer.

items.explain_vi: enjoy + V-ing → enjoyed listening.
manage + to V (xoay xở làm được) → managed to play.
'a piece of her own' = bản nhạc của chính Hân → cô ấy đã sáng tác (composed) nó.
put on a concert = tổ chức một buổi hoà nhạc. 'took part' phải có 'in' mới đúng.
'to' trong look forward to là giới từ → sau nó dùng V-ing: performing.

exam.intro_vi: Đề thi chung vào lớp 10 Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có bài 5 câu sắp xếp các lượt lời thành đoạn hội thoại hợp lý. Hôm nay em sắp xếp 6 lượt lời; lượt đầu tiên đã cho sẵn.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: tìm cặp hỏi – đáp (câu hỏi đuôi → Yes, I do), và từ nối như Well, Great, Sure để biết lượt nào đi sau lượt nào.
lines: A: Hi Minh! Our English club is putting on a short musical for the school open day. Do you want to take part?
B: I'd love to, but I'm not very good at acting. What else can I do?
A: Well, we still need someone to compose a few songs for the show. You play the guitar, don't you?
B: Yes, I do. I really enjoy writing my own songs, so I'd be happy to try.
A: Great! We're going to rehearse every Thursday after school. Can you come this week?
B: Sure. I'll remember to bring my guitar. See you on Thursday!
exam.explain_vi: B từ chối diễn và hỏi việc khác → A đề nghị sáng tác nhạc, hỏi 'You play the guitar, don't you?' → B 'Yes, I do' → A hẹn lịch tập → B nhận lời.

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề chuyên có bài đọc đoạn văn và chọn A, B, C hoặc D cho mỗi chỗ trống. Đoạn văn hôm nay ngắn, từ quen thuộc, có 5 chỗ trống về từ vựng và V-ing / to V.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: nhìn từ ngay TRƯỚC chỗ trống: enjoy → V-ing; want → to V; stopped to … = dừng lại để làm gì. Rồi đọc lại cả câu.
exam_easy.text:
My name is Nga, and I love art. Every Saturday, I go to a drawing club near my house. I really enjoy [1] pictures of animals and flowers there. Our teacher, Mr Long, is very [2]. He can draw a beautiful horse in only two minutes!

Last month, our club [3] an exhibition at the town library. Each student chose three pictures for it. I chose a picture of my cat, a picture of the sea and a picture of my grandmother. On the first day, a lot of people came, and many visitors stopped to [4] our pictures. My parents were very proud of me.

Next month, I want [5] part in a drawing competition for students in our city. I am a bit nervous, but I am also very excited!

items.explain_vi: Sau 'enjoy' luôn dùng V-ing: enjoy drawing (thích vẽ).
Câu sau nói thầy vẽ một con ngựa đẹp chỉ trong hai phút → thầy rất tài năng (talented).
put on an exhibition = tổ chức một cuộc triển lãm. Các cụm khác: thức dậy, tắt, ngồi xuống – không hợp nghĩa.
stopped to admire = dừng lại để ngắm nhìn (stop + to V: dừng lại để làm việc khác). Khách xem tranh, không nấu, giặt hay bán.
Sau 'want' dùng to V: want to take part in = muốn tham gia.

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề thi chung vào lớp 10 Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có bài sắp xếp các lượt lời thành đoạn hội thoại. Hôm nay em xếp 6 lượt lời ngắn; lượt đầu tiên đã cho sẵn.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: tìm câu hỏi rồi tìm câu trả lời của nó. Ví dụ: 'Are you free?' → 'Yes, I am.'; 'What time…?' → 'At seven o'clock.'
lines: A: Hi Lan! Are you free on Saturday evening?
A: My brother is singing in a music show at school. Do you want to come?
B: I'd love to! What time does it start?
A: At seven o'clock. Let's meet at the school gate at half past six.
exam_easy.explain_vi: Hỏi có rảnh không → 'Yes, I am. Why?' → nói lý do, mời đi xem → nhận lời, hỏi giờ → nói giờ, hẹn chỗ gặp → chào.

exam_plus.intro_vi: Trong 8 câu điền từ của đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ, câu phân loại thường hỏi cụm động từ gần nghĩa (take up / take on), kết hợp từ cố định và nghĩa khác nhau của V-ing / to V.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: với forget/remember/stop, hỏi: việc đó đã xảy ra chưa? Với kết hợp từ, chỉ một phương án đi được với từ đứng cạnh, đừng dịch từng chữ.
exam_plus.text:
When Bảo Anh first [1] the cello at the age of eleven, few people expected her to stick with it. The instrument was almost as tall as she was, and her fingers hurt after every lesson. However, she was determined, and she rarely missed a chance to practise. Her teacher, who had played in an orchestra for thirty years, kept reminding her that talent meant nothing without hard work.

At fifteen, she [2] in a national competition for young musicians. On the day, she was so nervous that she couldn't stop her hands [3], but as soon as she started playing, her fear disappeared. When she finished, the audience gave her a standing [4] that lasted almost two minutes. Since then, she has been invited to perform at concerts all over the country. Yet she says she will never forget [5] on that stage for the first time, with her heart beating faster than the music.

items.explain_vi: take up = bắt đầu học/chơi (sở thích, nhạc cụ). take on = nhận việc; take over = tiếp quản; take after = giống (người thân).
compete in a competition = thi đấu trong cuộc thi. entered/attended không cần 'in' (entered a competition); apply phải đi với 'for'.
stop sb/sth (from) doing = ngăn ai/cái gì làm gì: couldn't stop her hands shaking = không ngăn được tay mình run.
Kết hợp cố định: a standing ovation = khán giả đứng dậy vỗ tay. Không nói 'standing applause/praise'.
Việc đứng trên sân khấu đã xảy ra rồi → forget doing (quên việc đã làm). forget to do = quên việc phải làm.

exam_plus.intro_vi: Ở đề chung vào 10 Chuyên Ngoại ngữ, bài sắp xếp hội thoại khó thường không có cặp hỏi – đáp rõ ràng; em phải dựa vào từ quy chiếu (that, this one, then, in that case).
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: tìm từ trỏ ngược về lượt trước: 'That's exactly why…', 'this one', 'Then…'. Lượt chứa từ đó phải đứng ngay sau lượt nói về điều được nhắc tới.
lines: A: Did you know the city theatre is putting on a new version of 'Romeo and Juliet' next month?
B: I did, but to be honest, I'm not really into Shakespeare. I find the language really hard to follow.
A: That's exactly why you should see this one. The director has set the story in modern Hà Nội, and the actors speak everyday Vietnamese.
B: Really? In that case, it might be worth seeing. Are the tickets expensive?
A: Not at all – student tickets are only 80,000 đồng. But apparently they're selling out fast.
B: Then we'd better not wait. Remind me to book two seats when I get home tonight.
exam_plus.explain_vi: 'I did' đáp 'Did you know' → 'That's exactly why' nối 'hard to follow' → 'Not at all' đáp câu hỏi giá vé → 'Then…' nối 'selling out fast'.

paper_plus.instruction_vi: Dành cho mức Nâng cao. Câu 1–2: viết dạng đúng của từ in hoa (có thể phải thêm cả tiền tố lẫn hậu tố). Câu 3–4: viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn. Câu 5–6: chọn A, B, C hoặc D.

items.q: The concert was cancelled after the sudden ______ of the lead singer, who was found two days later at his parents' house. (APPEAR)
The stage design was rather ______; the director had simply copied it from an old production. (IMAGINE)
I told Hoa the ending of the film, and now I wish I hadn't. → I regret ______
items.answer: telling Hoa the ending of the film
accept: having told Hoa the ending of the film
telling her the ending of the film
having told her the ending of the film

items.q: 'Why don't we put on a play for Teachers' Day?' said Minh. → Minh suggested ______
items.answer: putting on a play for Teachers' Day
accept: that we put on a play for Teachers' Day
that we should put on a play for Teachers' Day
we put on a play for Teachers' Day
we should put on a play for Teachers' Day
that they put on a play for Teachers' Day
that they should put on a play for Teachers' Day
they put on a play for Teachers' Day
they should put on a play for Teachers' Day
putting a play on for Teachers' Day

items.q: Unfortunately, the band's new album didn't ______ their fans' high expectations.
Lan was so nervous before her first performance that she had ______ in her stomach.

writing_starters: Last …, I went to / took part in …
It was a … (show / concert / exhibition) at …
I hope to … again next year.

part1.intro_vi: Linh và Nam nói chuyện về buổi hoà nhạc của trường. Nghe và chọn đáp án đúng cho 5 câu hỏi.

script.t: Hi Nam! Are you going to take part in the school concert next week?
Yes, I am. I'm going to play the guitar with my band.
Great! What song are you going to play?
A song that my friend Tom composed. It's about the summer holidays.
That sounds fun. When do you rehearse?
Every Tuesday and Thursday after school, in the music room.
I love singing, but I'm too nervous to sing on stage in front of the whole school.
Then why don't you help with the posters? You're really good at drawing.
Good idea! I enjoy drawing much more than singing in front of people. How much are the tickets?
They're 20,000 dong each, and all the money goes to the school library.

items.q: What will Nam do at the concert?
items.explain_vi: Nam nói: "I'm going to play the guitar with my band."

items.q: Who wrote the song?
items.explain_vi: Nam nói: "A song that my friend Tom composed" (compose = sáng tác).

items.q: When does Nam's band rehearse?
items.explain_vi: Nam nói: "Every Tuesday and Thursday after school".

items.q: Why doesn't Linh want to sing at the concert?
items.explain_vi: Linh nói: "I'm too nervous to sing on stage."

items.q: What will the ticket money be used for?
items.explain_vi: Nam nói: "all the money goes to the school library."

part2.intro_vi: Em nghe lời chào mừng ở triển lãm mỹ thuật của trường. Nghe và điền vào ghi chú, mỗi chỗ 1 từ hoặc 1 con số.
part2.script: Hello, everyone, and welcome to our school art exhibition. This year, more than 60 students have taken part. You can see paintings, photos and models made from recycled paper. The paintings are in the main hall, and the photos are in Room 5, next to the library. Please don't touch the models, because they break very easily. At four o'clock, the school dance club will give a short performance in the garden. Before you leave, please vote for your favourite picture. Write its number on a card and put the card in the box at the door. The winner will get a set of art books. Thank you, and enjoy the exhibition!
part2.text:
SCHOOL ART EXHIBITION
• Number of students: more than [1]
• Photos: in Room [2]
• Models: made from recycled [3]
• Dance performance: in the [4]
• To vote: put your card in the [5] at the door

accept: sixty
items.explain_vi: "more than 60 students have taken part".

accept: five
items.explain_vi: "the photos are in Room 5, next to the library".
"models made from recycled paper".

accept: the garden
items.explain_vi: "a short performance in the garden".

accept: the box
items.explain_vi: "put the card in the box at the door".

part1.intro_vi: Tom rủ Mai đi xem một triển lãm tranh vào cuối tuần. Nghe và chọn đáp án đúng. Chú ý chỗ người nói đổi ý hoặc sửa lại.

script.t: Mai, do you fancy doing something this weekend? There's a new exhibition of Vietnamese paintings at the city museum.
Oh, I'd love to see it. Is it on Saturday?
Well, it opens on Saturday, but it'll be really crowded on the first day. I'd rather go on Sunday morning.
Sunday morning is fine. Oh, wait, I've got my piano lesson then. How about Sunday afternoon?
OK, Sunday afternoon it is. Do you know how much the tickets are?
I think they're 50,000 dong. No, sorry, that's the price for adults. For students, it's 30,000.
Not bad. My art teacher saw some of the paintings last month. She said the ones by a young artist from Hue were amazing.
I really admire artists who paint with so much imagination. I'd love to try painting like that one day.
Why don't you join the art club at school? They put on an exhibition every summer.
Maybe. I'm not sure I'm talented enough, though.
Don't worry, everyone starts as a beginner. And remember to bring your student card on Sunday, or you'll have to pay the full price!
Good point. I'll put it in my bag tonight.

items.q: Why doesn't Tom want to go on Saturday?
options: Tickets are more expensive that day.
There will be too many people.
items.explain_vi: Tom: "it'll be really crowded on the first day" (crowded = đông người). Mai mới là người học piano.

items.q: When will they go to the exhibition?
items.explain_vi: Tom muốn đi sáng Chủ nhật nhưng Mai bận học piano, nên chốt: "Sunday afternoon it is."

items.q: How much does a student ticket cost?
items.explain_vi: Mai nói 50,000 rồi sửa: đó là giá người lớn; "For students, it's 30,000."

items.q: What does Mai admire about some artists?
items.explain_vi: Mai: "artists who paint with so much imagination" (imagination = trí tưởng tượng, sáng tạo).

items.q: What does Tom remind Mai to do?
items.explain_vi: Tom: "remember to bring your student card on Sunday". Câu lạc bộ mỹ thuật chỉ là lời gợi ý.

part2.intro_vi: Thầy giáo câu lạc bộ kịch dặn dò học sinh trước khi tập vở kịch mới. Điền vào ghi chú, mỗi chỗ 1–2 từ hoặc 1 con số.
part2.script: OK, everyone, listen carefully, please. As you know, our drama club is putting on a play called The Magic Forest at the end of term. Rehearsals start next Monday, and we'll rehearse three times a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Oh, sorry, not Friday. I've just checked the hall timetable, and it's Thursday. Each rehearsal lasts 2 hours, so please don't plan anything else after school on those days. Try to learn your lines before the first rehearsal, and don't forget to bring your script every time. If you can't come, remember to send me a message. We also need some help with the costumes. Linh's mother, who works as a designer, has kindly offered to help us. She needs lots of old clothes, so please bring any that you don't wear any more. Right, any questions?
part2.text:
DRAMA CLUB: THE MAGIC FOREST
• Rehearsal days: Monday, Wednesday and [1]
• Each rehearsal lasts: [2] hours
• Before the first rehearsal: learn your [3]
• Help with costumes: Linh's [4]
• Please bring: old [5]

items.explain_vi: Thầy nói Friday rồi sửa: "not Friday... it's Thursday".

accept: two
items.explain_vi: "Each rehearsal lasts 2 hours".
"Try to learn your lines before the first rehearsal".

accept: mum
mom
items.explain_vi: "Linh's mother, who works as a designer, has kindly offered to help us".
"She needs lots of old clothes".

part1.intro_vi: Anna và Nam bàn chuyện tham gia cuộc thi tài năng của trường. Nghe và chọn đáp án đúng. Có câu hỏi về cảm xúc, ý kiến và suy luận.

script.t: Nam, have you signed up for the talent show yet? The list closes on Friday.
Not yet. To be honest, I'm in two minds about it. I've been practising the violin a lot, but performing in front of the whole school is a different thing.
Come on, you're one of the most talented players I know. Remember playing at your cousin's wedding? Everyone loved it.
That was different. Most of the guests were my relatives, so I didn't feel like anyone was judging me.
Fair enough. But what's the worst that could happen?
I could forget the notes halfway through! Anyway, if I did enter, I'd want to play something original rather than a famous piece.
You mean compose your own music? That's quite ambitious with only three weeks to go.
I know. Actually, I started writing something last month. It was inspired by the sound of rain on our roof. But it's only half finished.
Then why not play it with someone else? I could play the piano with you, and we could rehearse at my house.
Really? That would make me feel much less nervous. But wouldn't you rather enter on your own? You won second prize last year.
Honestly, I'd enjoy playing with someone much more. Performing alone last year was quite lonely.
All right, you've persuaded me. Let's give it a go. I'll finish the piece this weekend.
Great! I'll put our names on the list tomorrow morning.

items.q: How does Nam feel about the talent show at the beginning?
options: Unable to decide whether to enter
Not interested in it at all
items.explain_vi: Nam: "I'm in two minds about it" (phân vân, chưa quyết định được).

items.q: Why did Nam feel comfortable playing at his cousin's wedding?
options: He had practised the piece for months.
He knew most of the people listening.
He was playing a famous piece.
items.explain_vi: Nam: "Most of the guests were my relatives, so I didn't feel like anyone was judging me."

items.q: What does Anna think about Nam's plan to write his own music?
options: It's a lot to manage in such a short time.
It's too easy for a talented player.
It will certainly win a prize.
It's less interesting than a famous piece.
items.explain_vi: Anna: "That's quite ambitious with only three weeks to go" (tham vọng, khó kịp).

items.q: What gave Nam the idea for his music?
options: A song he heard at the wedding
A piece Anna played last year
items.explain_vi: Nam: "It was inspired by the sound of rain on our roof."

items.q: Why does Anna want to perform with Nam rather than alone?
options: She doesn't want to win again.
She thinks it would be more enjoyable.
She needs more practice on the piano.
items.explain_vi: Anna: "I'd enjoy playing with someone much more. Performing alone last year was quite lonely."

part2.intro_vi: Em nghe một bài nhận xét trên đài về vở nhạc kịch mới của nhà hát thiếu nhi. Điền ghi chú, mỗi chỗ 1–2 từ hoặc 1 con số.
part2.script: Good evening, and welcome to Arts Weekly. This week I went to see Moonlight River, a new musical put on by the City Youth Theatre. The story follows a young girl who travels along a river to find her lost brother. What impressed me most was not the singing, although that was strong, but the stage design. Instead of expensive scenery, the designers used hundreds of paper lanterns to create the river, and the effect was magical. The music was composed by a student who is still at secondary school, which is remarkable when you consider how complex some of the songs are. The cast are all aged between 12 and 18, and they have clearly spent months rehearsing. The only real weakness, in my opinion, is the length. At almost three hours, the show is about 40 minutes too long, and some younger members of the audience were getting restless by the end. Performances start at half past seven every evening except Monday. Tickets cost 150,000 dong, but students pay only 90,000. Overall, I'd strongly recommend it.
part2.text:
REVIEW: MOONLIGHT RIVER
• What impressed the reviewer most: the stage [1]
• The river was made from paper [2]
• Age of the cast: between 12 and [3]
• Main weakness: the [4] of the show
• Student ticket: [5] dong

items.explain_vi: "not the singing... but the stage design". Phần hát chỉ là thông tin gây nhiễu.

accept: lantern
items.explain_vi: "used hundreds of paper lanterns to create the river".

accept: eighteen
items.explain_vi: "The cast are all aged between 12 and 18".
"The only real weakness... is the length". 40 phút là thời gian bị thừa.

accept: ninety thousand
items.explain_vi: Giá vé 150,000 là vé thường; "students pay only 90,000".
